reason: The README clearly defines a DeepSeek Harness plugin focused on automating permission-review of tool actions by adding a new “替我审核” preset and routing workspace-command approvals through policy/model checks, with human fallback and logging; this aligns most closely with automation of workflow/approval control rather than code generation, research, UI changes, or direct data/document processing.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供“替我审核”权限模式，通过规则与模型判断自动分流工具和终端操作审批，在不确定时转交人工确认。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a "review on my behalf" permission mode for DeepSeek Harness that automates tool/action approval routing with rule and model checks, while falling back to human confirmation when uncertain.

capabilities: Adds a new permission preset to automate approval handling for session tool requests
Applies a three-stage decision funnel (whitelist, blocklist, reviewer model) before execution escalation
Supports zero-token auto-approval and zero-token interception paths for certain command patterns
Lets users configure reviewer model/provider and fallback behavior for judgment routing
Emits structured verdict logs and concise in-session decision notices

reasons.code: README describes a fourth permission preset "review" with workspace-write + ask semantics and an escalation funnel for asks.
README specifies whitelist and blocklist command handling, plus a reviewer model layer for gray-zone decisions.
README documents reviewer model selection in Settings (follow session model or fixed model) and route fallback behavior.
README lists safety-related limits and controls such as max auto-approvals, preflight/interception, deny behavior, and concurrent/timeout settings.
README states audit output as review/verdict records with decision/source/route metadata.
